sections.text_helper: Section 43.4.17 "Output interface polarity" in chapter 43 (LCD-TFT display controller (LTDC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2112.
sections.section_content:
The polarity of the control signals of the output interface includes the clock polarity,
thevertical/horizontal synchronization, and the data-enable signal.
Parameters in LTDC_GCR
• PCPOL: polarity of the output clock
• VSPOL: polarity of the vertical synchronization
• HSPOL: polarity of the vertical synchronization
• DEPOL: polarity of the data enable
Default configuration
There is not default configuration, as the configuration of the polarity depends on the display
panel specifications.
The following configuration can be used to have all items working with a positive polarity:
• PCPOL=1 (rising-edge)
• VSPOL=1 (active high)
• HSPOL=1 (active high)
• DEPOL=1 (active high)
